context.text: Hey Sam! Ten pages of Dune on the couch at 7 tonight. Ready?

ugh yeah yesterday got away from me
Totally fair, one miss is just a slip. Today's the one that matters, so tonight at 7 it's you, Dune and the couch. What got in the way yesterday?
Hey Sam! Ten minutes to 7. Grab Dune and get settled on the couch, ten pages tonight. Then send me a quick voice note on where you stopped. Ready to go?
[voice: Ten pages of Dune done on the couch, I stopped right where Paul meets the Fremen] done, all 10 pages
That's how you bounce back, Sam! Ten pages done and the miss is behind you 📚 Paul meeting the Fremen is a great place to stop. How did tonight feel, easy to sink into or a bit of a push?
